UPDATE mcu_media SET
  director = 'Various (showrunners: Dario Scardapane)',
  `cast` = 'Charlie Cox as Matt Murdock / Daredevil, Vincent D''Onofrio as Wilson Fisk / Kingpin, Jon Bernthal as Frank Castle / The Punisher, Deborah Ann Woll as Karen Page, Elden Henson as Foggy Nelson, Margarita Levieva as Heather Glenn, Michael Gandolfini as Daniel Butch',
  tagline = 'The Devil of Hell''s Kitchen is reborn. Charlie Cox returns in Marvel''s most anticipated series.',
  description = 'Daredevil: Born Again follows Matt Murdock as he navigates a New York where Wilson Fisk has become Mayor, using his position to wage war on vigilantes while Matt must balance his legal career with his nighttime activities as Daredevil.',
  imageUrl = 'https://d2xsxph8kpxj0f.cloudfront.net/310419663027009739/SGHqXeh8PZJcCDnFiAMuFi/daredevil-born-again-featured-2LXKXXmJQTXmzHdxQpvL5c.webp',
  episodeCount = 9, seasonCount = 1, platform = 'Disney+',
  rtCriticsScore = 88, rtAudienceScore = 91, verdict = 'hit',
  cardMarketContent = '## Daredevil Born Again Cards: The Most Anticipated MCU Cards

Daredevil: Born Again cards are among the most anticipated Marvel card releases. Charlie Cox''s definitive return, Jon Bernthal''s Punisher, and Kingpin as Mayor create a trifecta of collecting excitement. These cards bridge the Netflix era with the modern MCU, making them historically significant for the hobby.',
  keyCards = '- **2025 Upper Deck Daredevil Born Again Charlie Cox** — The definitive MCU Daredevil card, $15-40
- **2025 Upper Deck Born Again Kingpin Mayor Fisk** — Political villain evolution, $10-30
- **2025 Upper Deck Born Again Punisher Return** — Jon Bernthal''s MCU return, $15-35
- **2025 Upper Deck Born Again Charlie Cox Auto** — Premium autograph card, $200-500+',
  content = '## The Devil Returns

Daredevil: Born Again was the most anticipated Marvel Disney+ series — and it delivered. Charlie Cox''s Matt Murdock returned in full force, navigating a New York where his greatest enemy had become the most powerful man in the city. The show honored the Netflix legacy while carving its own identity within the MCU.

## Mayor Fisk

Vincent D''Onofrio''s Wilson Fisk as Mayor of New York was terrifying in a new way. No longer operating from the shadows, Fisk used the full power of government to wage war on vigilantes. His political machinations made him more dangerous than ever — a villain who could destroy you with a press conference.

## The Punisher Returns

Jon Bernthal''s return as Frank Castle was everything fans hoped for. His dynamic with Matt Murdock — the eternal debate between justice and vengeance — remained the most compelling relationship in street-level Marvel. Their scenes together crackled with the same intensity as the Netflix era.

## Fun Facts

- The show was completely reworked after initial filming, with new showrunner Dario Scardapane
- Charlie Cox has said this version of Matt Murdock is the same character from Netflix
- The show was renewed for Season 2 before Season 1 finished airing
- Michael Gandolfini (son of James Gandolfini) plays a key role
- The hallway fight tradition continues with new iconic action sequences',
  metaDescription = 'Daredevil: Born Again (2025) guide — Charlie Cox returns, Mayor Fisk, Punisher, trading card values, and why this is the MCU''s most anticipated series.',
  keywords = 'daredevil born again, charlie cox, kingpin, mayor fisk, punisher, jon bernthal, disney plus marvel, marvel cards, hell''s kitchen',
  ebaySearchTerm = 'Upper Deck Marvel Daredevil Born Again cards 2025',
  faqData = '[{"question":"Is Daredevil Born Again connected to the Netflix series?","answer":"Yes, it is a continuation of the same character. Charlie Cox and Vincent D''Onofrio play the same versions of Matt Murdock and Wilson Fisk from the Netflix era."},{"question":"Do I need to watch the Netflix Daredevil first?","answer":"While Born Again works as a standalone, watching the Netflix series (especially Seasons 1 and 3) provides essential character context and makes the emotional beats hit much harder."},{"question":"Is the Punisher in Born Again?","answer":"Yes, Jon Bernthal returns as Frank Castle/The Punisher in a significant role, continuing his character from the Netflix era."}]',
  status = 'published'
WHERE slug = 'daredevil-born-again-2025'
